items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Buddy Jones used to cut hair... Buddy Jones they had more of a musical band big time.

ctx.x: All down there they first had business places there, ballrooms and they even had a club, a young man club there, people that upstairs had a club there too. Then down there they had two barbershops and things all that. But Yank and Buddy Jones used to cut hair, you see? Yeah.
Which was the best trombonist did you think? Yank or his brother? Buddy?
